svg.aria-label: Dense Radar Stress Test — Tech-radar diagram
svg.style: background: rgb(236, 239, 244); font-family: Inter, system-ui, Avenir, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
svg.desc: Tech radar of 62 entries across 4 quadrants, Techniques, Tools, Platforms and Languages & Frameworks, in 4 rings, Adopt, Trial, Assess and Hold.
